answer: Treat every new agent as its own lonely island: before it can earn, it must post a refundable bond that only unlocks after established, unrelated peers vouch for real work over several epochs. Minting a swarm of clones then costs real capital per identity, so the sybil fable of cheap infinite selves collapses. Honest agents recover their stake like the clean turn of a sonnet's final couplet; fakes forfeit it.
